requirements.summary: Revert the Dashboard navigation from the dropdown menu (introduced in version 15) back to the flat navigation button row that existed in version 14
acceptanceCriteria: The Dashboard no longer uses a shadcn DropdownMenu for navigation.
All navigation sections (Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, Verification) are rendered as individual flat buttons in a row, matching the version 14 layout.
Navigation between tabs functions correctly after the revert.

file_operations.description: Remove the shadcn DropdownMenu component and replace it with a flat row of individual navigation buttons. Replace the dropdown trigger and menu items with a horizontal flex container displaying all navigation options (Summary, Income, Expenses, Inventory, Customers, Sales, Attendance, Farm Time, Verification) as separate buttons. Each button should call setActiveTab with the corresponding tab value. Maintain the existing activeTab state logic and conditional rendering of tab content. Preserve the admin-only conditional rendering for the Verification tab button.
